title: EngineStatus
description: Where the engine is in the match it is following.

state.title: EngineState
state.description: `waiting` for a match; `rebuilding` state from events that already happened (after a seek or a mid-match connect); `live`; or the match has `ended`.

generation.description: The generation of the last MatchReset.

teams.description: The teams seen so far, in order of first appearance.

period.description: Period of the latest event processed.

match_clock_s.description: Game clock of the latest event processed.

play_s.description: Seconds of play so far, continuous across periods.

rebuilding_to.description: While `rebuilding`: the offset where live play resumes.

late_dropped.description: Events dropped for arriving too late to reorder.
